snippet.title: Block King Demands Red Squares | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Official gameplay trailer for Block King Demands Red Square which releases on Steam on November 2026. 
Shows off some of the style of story and gameplay you can expect from the game. The main focus of the game will be setting up the logistics network to produce the shapes you need.

Wishlist the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3447670/Block_King_Demands_Red_Squares/
